summary: A trustee stays at the table after the term ends while the mayor chooses a successor.
realLife: At the May 2024 annual meeting, Boston trustees heard that Chynah Tyler would continue serving until the mayor appointed her replacement.
inGame: needs: appointment record and local holdover rule.

turns.pulledBy: The successor takes office before the next meeting.
turns.what: The outgoing trustee passes on the branch file.
turns.writesBack: The next roll names the successor.

turns.pulledBy: The appointment is still pending when the board meets.
turns.what: The clerk calls the continuing trustee's name.
turns.writesBack: The minutes identify who actually held the seat.
